whyMatters.en: Detroit duo that stripped blues-garage to guitar/drums/vocal; Elephant (2003) and Seven Nation Army made minimal lineup a global riff brand.
whyMatters.zh: 底特律双人组：把蓝调车库压成吉他/鼓/人声；Elephant（2003）与 Seven Nation Army 让最小编制成为全球 riff 品牌。

shortBio.en: Jack / Meg White blues-garage; Seven Nation Army is the stadium chant riff.
shortBio.zh: Jack / Meg White 的蓝调车库；Seven Nation Army 是体育场口号 riff。

body.en:
Formed 1997. Early Sympathy for the Record Industry releases and White Blood Cells kept recording raw; Elephant (Liam Watson / Toe Rag) hit mainstream without adding bass.

Seven Nation Army (2003) is the listed riff—octave pedal illusion of bass. Proof that early-2000s rock radio still answered to garage reduction, not only nu-metal density.
body.zh:
1997 年组建。早期 Sympathy for the Record Industry 发行与 White Blood Cells 保持毛糙录音；Elephant（Liam Watson / Toe Rag）打进主流且不加贝斯。

Seven Nation Army（2003）是列出 riff——八度效果器制造的假贝斯。证明 2000 年代初摇滚电台仍回应车库减法，而非只有 nu-metal 密度。
